name: Vince Vivian Vickers
original_name: ヴィンス ヴィヴィアン ヴィッカーズ
source:
1st year high school student.
Kind and courteous, he's good at taking care of others. He's regarded as an ideal "older brother type", but is actually the youngest brother in his large family. He excels in alchemical magic and herbal medicine studies.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
